nodes.title: With agent handOff.warmSummary, a Plivo transfer's Dial carries confirmSound pointing at a signed runtime hook; when the colleague answers, Plivo speaks (its own en-IN voice) a short English summary built in code (who handed off, the caller's name, why, goals settled, and the caller's last words only when in Latin letters) before the caller is connected
nodes.rationale: Must-be audit brief 6: warmSummary was configurable and never spoken. Plivo Dial confirmSound per its docs (fetched with POST, Speak/Play/Wait only, played to the called party on answer); not verified on a live transfer.
nodes.reverse_if: a live transfer shows confirmSound needs confirmKey or plays after connecting (then use a separate B-leg answer URL), or teams want the summary in Hindi (then a hi-IN Speak voice and the caller's words verbatim)
